dogecoin.text: This chart shows #memecoins fading into irrelevance since the May 2021 crash. Even the most resilient memecoin $DOGE is losing dominance, from 3.3% at peak to 1.5% today. Maybe someday memecoins will make a comeback, but may have to wait a long time for the next perfect storm. https://t.co/3UxisCEI0U

$SHIB have overtaken $DOGE to become the largest memecoin in marketcap, despite Elon claiming he owns 0 SHIB and the rest of the market in correction mode, it is now ranked #9 and has $33B in marketcap.

These two are the $AMC and $GME in the #crypto world. https://t.co/uxByerj1bi

Not a bad strategy. Definitely putting a little lotto money on $SHIB and $DOGE during the bottom of next bear market, perhaps 0.5%-1% of total portfolio.

Capped downside, almost infinite upside if you got in at the right prices.

Unlike $DOGE and $SHIB that actually have a loyal #HODL fan base and good social media marketing, most #memecoins will not likely see their ATH again. 

Heck, most #altcoins don't even see their ATH again. 😄 https://t.co/aV5kfOC2ds
